rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Generation seconds shift hours of validation onto scarce skilled reviewers.
rationale.automation-bias: Polished outputs reduce scrutiny while dependency erodes reviewer detection skill.
rationale.oversight-theater: Pro forma owners and rubber-stamped reviews lack time, skill, or authority.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Tiered validation mandates tests, automated checks, sampling, and boundary monitoring.
rationale.risk-routing: Independent risk inputs allocate tasks among review and autonomy tiers.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Named owners exercise checklist gates, approvals, demotions, and escalation.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Domain checklists and provenance records support human judgment of outputs.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Bounded-autonomy tiers monitor parameters and trigger exceptions or rapid demotion.
rationale.org-governance: Defines accountability roles, registries, audit records, policies, and PMO scaling.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent registry records AI delegation, ownership, rationale, outcomes, and review.
rationale.framework: Reusable protocol architecture integrates delegation, validation, metrics, and Agile workflows.
rationale.design-only: Only illustrative demonstration and analytical evaluation; field validation remains future work.
rationale.general-ai: Governs AI-produced knowledge work across software and non-software domains.
rationale.non-developer: Explicitly covers consulting, marketing, legal, research, and other professionals.
rationale.assistive: Tier 1 covers human-driven, suggestion-granularity AI assistance.
rationale.agentic: Tiers 2–4 govern AI-produced artifacts and autonomous bounded work.
rationale.metrics: Defines quality metrics: error rates, false acceptance, and validation effort.
rationale.risk-quality: Checklists and outcome tracking mitigate non-security output-quality failures.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Competence maintenance and cognitive-hygiene protocols address dependency and complacency.
